_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/data/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

cartridge_name.note: Cartridge designation as THIS source spells it. Uses more aggressive abbreviation than cartridge_pressures.csv - e.g. ".45-06 Rem" here against ".45-06 Remington" in the primary file - so the loader's name index is what reconciles them, and the residual mismatches are the conflicts table.

pressure_value.note: The pressure figure. Always read together with pressure_unit.

pressure_unit.note: Unit of pressure_value. Constrained rather than free text, because a number without a trustworthy unit is worse than no number for a load-adjacent table.

family.note: Family as this source classifies it. Present here but not in the primary compilation; it is NOT used to create a cartridge, because a wrong family files a pistol cartridge on a rifle page.

source_url.note: Where the figure was read. Provenance is mandatory in spirit for pressure data.

source_kind.note: Whether this is a standards body's own figure or someone's compilation of them. 'compilation' ranks below 'standard' when both claim a cartridge.

source_note.note: How the value was derived. May contain commas; keep quoted.
